standard_prerequisites.name: Hom modules between finite modules over a Noetherian ring are finite
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Algebra, Lemma \ref{algebra-lemma-ext-noetherian}, cited at proof lines 5263-5264
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes the duals and double duals finite modules, so the diagram chase is a statement about finite modules.

standard_prerequisites.name: A finite module over a Noetherian domain is torsion free if and only if the map to its double dual is injective
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives injectivity of the right vertical arrow of the diagram.

standard_prerequisites.name: Localisation at the fraction field is compatible with Hom out of a finitely presented module
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Algebra, Lemma \ref{algebra-lemma-hom-from-finitely-presented}, cited at proof line 5288
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the exact sequence of vector spaces whose exactness forces Q tensored with the fraction field to vanish.

core_obligations: Dualise the given exact sequence and dualise once more to obtain the commutative diagram (proof lines 5265-5271).
Record that the middle vertical arrow is an isomorphism and the right vertical arrow is injective (proof lines 5272-5274).
Reduce the lemma to the claim that the left vertical arrow is injective, and check that a diagram chase then gives the conclusion (proof lines 5274-5278).
Define the cokernel Q of the dualised sequence and show Q tensored with the fraction field vanishes using the finite presentation lemma (proof lines 5281-5293).
Deduce that Q is torsion, hence has no nontrivial maps to the ring, and conclude injectivity of the arrow on double duals of the kernel (proof lines 5294-5306).
proof_roadmap: Extract the two known properties of its vertical arrows (proof lines 5272-5274).
Reduce to a single injectivity claim (proof lines 5274-5278).
Prove the claim via the torsion cokernel Q (proof lines 5281-5306).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that in an exact sequence of finite modules over a Noetherian domain, reflexivity of the middle term together with torsion freeness of the quotient forces reflexivity of the kernel. The proof dualises the sequence twice to obtain a commutative diagram in which the middle vertical arrow is an isomorphism and the right one is injective, reduces to the claim that the map induced on the double duals of the kernel is injective, and then proves that claim: the cokernel Q of the dualised sequence becomes zero after tensoring with the fraction field, because the map on the fraction fields is a split injection of vector spaces, so Q is torsion and has no maps into the ring. A diagram chase then identifies the left vertical arrow as an isomorphism.
